turns.question: How many monthly active customers did we have on 3 October 2026?
turns.answer: We had 10 engaged customers (customers with any site or CRM action) in the 28 days ending 3 October 2026, which is the semantic layer's closest metric to monthly active customers; active customers, which count non-cancelled orders, is a different measure. Late: customer_actions.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
